services.name: Aadhaar Enrolment & Update
services.description: 12-digit unique identity number issued by UIDAI to residents of India, based on demographic and biometric data. Used as proof of identity and address and as a KYC token across government and private services.
services.eligibility: Any resident of India (including infants) irrespective of citizenship status of parents for enrolment; updates available to existing holders.
services.benefits: Single portable ID accepted nationwide; enables DBT, subsidy linkage, KYC, and access to many government schemes.
optional_documents: Introducer / Head of Family based enrolment where documents unavailable
services.application_mode: Offline (Enrolment Centre) and Online update (SSUP / mAadhaar)
application_steps: Locate nearest Aadhaar enrolment centre / Aadhaar Seva Kendra.
Fill enrolment/update form and submit supporting documents.
Collect acknowledgement slip with Enrolment ID (EID).
Download e-Aadhaar once UID is generated (verify on uidai.gov.in).
services.processing_time: Enrolment: up to 90 days for UID generation (typically sooner). Update: up to 30 days.
services.fees: Enrolment: free. Demographic update: free. Biometric update: Rs. 100 (inclusive of GST) as per UIDAI fee schedule.
services.validity: Lifelong (subject to deactivation for residents who acquire foreign citizenship).
services.office_locator_info: Aadhaar Seva Kendra locator at https://bhuvan.uidai.gov.in/locator

faq.q: Is Aadhaar mandatory for all schemes?
faq.a: Aadhaar is required for subsidies/benefits under Section 7 schemes; alternative ID is permitted where Aadhaar not yet assigned.
Use the TOTP-based lock feature on myAadhaar portal or mAadhaar app.

services.languages_available: Hindi, English and 21 scheduled languages on portal/app
services.ai_summary: Aadhaar is India's 12-digit resident identity number issued by UIDAI, used for KYC and government benefit delivery.
services.ai_explanation: Aadhaar links a resident's identity to demographic and biometric data. It is the foundational ID for Direct Benefit Transfer, opening bank accounts, filing taxes, and availing schemes. Enrolment is free; updates may carry a fee. It is not proof of citizenship.

Using unofficial paid agents instead of authorised centres
Not updating mobile number for OTP-based services

services.name: Passport Issuance (Passport Seva)
services.description: Issuance/renewal of Indian passports (ordinary, Tatkaal, diplomatic/official) by the Ministry of External Affairs through Passport Seva Kendras (PSK) and Post Office PSKs.
services.eligibility: Indian citizen; must provide proof of date of birth, address, and nationality. Minors require parent consent.
services.benefits: Internationally recognised travel document; enables visa-free/visa-on-arrival access; Tatkaal for urgent issue.
required_documents: Proof of nationality / old passport (if renewing)
services.application_mode: Online application + in-person appointment at PSK
application_steps: Register on passportindia.gov.in and fill the application form.
Pay fee and book appointment at nearest PSK/PopSK.
Visit PSK with originals + photocopies for document verification and biometric capture.
Police verification (for fresh passports) at registered address.
Passport printed and dispatched; track status online.
services.processing_time: Tatkaal: ~1-3 days post verification. Normal: ~30 days (post police verification).
services.fees: Normal 36-page: Rs. 1500. Tatkaal 36-page: Rs. 3500. (10-year validity for adults; minors 5 years / till age 18).
services.validity: 10 years for adults; 5 years or till age 18 for minors.
services.office_locator_info: PSK/PopSK locator at https://passportindia.gov.in -> 'Locate PSK'

faq.q: Can I apply from a different state than my address?
faq.a: You must apply from your current address jurisdiction; police verification happens at the address given.

faq.q: What is the difference between Normal and Tatkaal?
faq.a: Tatkaal is an expedited service with higher fees and pre-verification; Normal follows standard police verification.

services.ai_summary: Passport Seva issues Indian passports online with in-person verification at PSKs; Normal ~30 days, Tatkaal expedited.
services.ai_explanation: Citizens apply online, pay a fee, and attend a PSK appointment for document checks and biometrics. Police verification follows for fresh passports. Tatkaal offers faster issue at higher cost. Passports are valid 10 years for adults.

What are the passport fees?
How long does a passport take?
How do I renew my passport?
common_mistakes: Mismatch between address proof and application
suggested_followups: What documents prove address for passport?
How do I track my passport application status?

services.name: Voter ID / Electoral Roll Enrolment (Form 6)
services.description: Registration of names in the electoral roll and issuance of Electors Photo Identity Card (EPIC / Voter ID) by the Election Commission of India.
services.eligibility: Indian citizen, 18+ years on qualifying date, ordinary resident of the constituency.
services.benefits: Right to vote in elections; EPIC serves as identity and address proof.
services.application_mode: Online (NVSP / Voter Helpline app) and offline (BLO/ERO)
application_steps: Visit nvsp.in or voterportal.eci.gov.in and register/login.
Fill Form 6 (new enrolment) with details and upload documents.
BLO verifies at residence; name added to draft roll.
services.processing_time: Typically 2-4 weeks after verification; before each summary revision.
services.fees: Free.
services.validity: Until deletion on account of death, shift, or disqualification.
services.office_locator_info: District Electoral Officer / ERO offices; locate via NVSP.

faq.a: Yes, under Form 6A if aged 18+ and not enrolled in India.

faq.q: Is Aadhaar mandatory for voter enrolment?
faq.a: No, Aadhaar is voluntary for identity; other documents are accepted.

services.ai_summary: ECI issues Voter ID (EPIC) to citizens 18+ via Form 6; free, online through NVSP.
services.ai_explanation: Any Indian citizen aged 18 can enrol in the electoral roll using Form 6 on NVSP. After BLO verification the name is added and an e-EPIC can be downloaded. The Voter ID also works as ID/address proof.

How do I correct my name in the voter list?
What is Form 6?

services.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
services.description: Direct income support of Rs. 6,000/year to eligible farmer families, paid in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 directly into bank accounts.
services.eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families (cultivable landholding) as per land records; excludes institutional landholders, higher-income categories.
services.benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year direct transfer; supports farm input costs.
services.application_mode: Online (pmkisan.gov.in), CSC, or nearest agriculture office
application_steps: Verify and submit; note registration number.
Instalments credited to bank account; check status online.
services.processing_time: Instalments released periodically; first credit after verification (weeks).
services.fees: Free.
services.validity: Continuous while eligibility and land records valid; e-KYC required periodically.
services.office_locator_info: State/District Agriculture Offices; CSC centres.

faq.a: Commonly due to Aadhaar-bank seeding mismatch or pending e-KYC; complete e-KYC on the portal.
Benefit is linked to landholding records in the owner's name; tenant farmers are generally not separate beneficiaries.

services.ai_summary: PM-KISAN gives eligible farmer families Rs. 6,000/year in 3 DBT instalments; free, Aadhaar-linked.
services.ai_explanation: The scheme transfers Rs. 2,000 every four months to farmer families owning cultivable land, subject to exclusion criteria. Registration needs Aadhaar, a DBT bank account, and land records. Periodic e-KYC is mandatory to keep receiving benefits.

common_mistakes: Aadhaar not linked to bank account
suggested_followups: How do I link Aadhaar to my bank for PM-KISAN?

services.name: eNAM (National Agriculture Market)
services.description: Online trading platform integrating APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
services.eligibility: Farmers, traders, and FPOs registered with linked APMC mandis.
services.benefits: Better price discovery, transparent bidding, wider buyer reach, reduced intermediaries.
application_steps: Link APMC mandi and bank account.
Payment settled to farmer account post-trade.
services.processing_time: Trade settlement as per mandi rules (typically within mandated days).
services.fees: Transaction charges as per APMC bye-laws; platform access free for farmers.
services.validity: Account active while KYC valid.
services.office_locator_info: Linked APMC mandis across participating states.

faq.a: Most states with APMC integration; check the mandi list on the portal.

services.ai_summary: eNAM is a unified online agriculture trading platform linking APMC mandis for transparent price discovery.
services.ai_explanation: eNAM lets farmers and traders transact across mandis through e-auction, improving price discovery and reducing middlemen. Farmers register free and link their mandi and bank account; traders need a licence.

services.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
services.description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to eligible poor and vulnerable families.
services.eligibility: Based on SECC deprivation criteria and socio-economic parameters; beneficiaries identified via NHA database. States may expand.
services.benefits: Cashless treatment at empanelled public/private hospitals; no cap on family size/age.
services.application_mode: Through Ayushman Bharat Kendras / CSC / hospital helpdesk
application_steps: Check eligibility via pmjay.gov.in 'Am I Eligible'.
Visit Ayushman Bharat / CSC kendra with ID.
Visit empanelled hospital; show card at helpdesk.
Cashless admission and treatment; claim settled directly.
services.processing_time: Card creation same day; treatment cashless at empanelled hospitals.
services.fees: Free for eligible beneficiaries (no premium).
services.validity: Annual cover resets each financial year; card valid while eligible.
services.office_locator_info: Ayushman Bharat Digital Kendras; empanelled hospital list on portal.

faq.q: How do I know if I am eligible?
faq.a: Search your name by state/district/SECC ID on the Beneficiary Portal.

faq.q: Is there a premium to pay?
faq.a: No. The scheme is fully funded by Government; beneficiaries pay nothing at empanelled hospitals.

services.ai_summary: PM-JAY gives eligible families Rs. 5 lakh/year cashless hospitalization; free, SECC-based eligibility.
services.ai_explanation: PM-JAY covers secondary/tertiary hospitalization costs up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for poor and vulnerable households identified via SECC. Beneficiaries get an Ayushman card and receive cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals with no out-of-pocket premium.

Link PHR address and records from providers.

services.fees: Free.

services.office_locator_info: ABDM-enabled health facilities and CSCs.

Sharing is consent-based and governed by the ABDM data-sharing framework.

services.ai_summary: ABDM provides a voluntary ABHA health ID to link and consent-share medical records across providers.
services.ai_explanation: ABDM builds a digital health infrastructure where residents create an ABHA ID to consolidate health records and share them with providers on a consent basis. It is free and voluntary, improving continuity of care.

services.name: e-Shram (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
services.description: National database and registration of unorganised sector workers to extend social security benefits.
services.eligibility: Unorganised workers aged 16-59, not members of EPFO/ESIC, with Aadhaar.
services.benefits: e-Shram card; eligibility for future social security/welfare schemes; portability.
application_steps: Visit eshram.gov.in; self-register with Aadhaar OTP.
Fill personal, occupation, and bank details.
services.processing_time: Instant card generation after Aadhaar OTP verification.
services.fees: Free.
services.validity: Card valid; update on change of details.
services.office_locator_info: CSC centres; State Labour Departments.

faq.a: Unorganised workers not covered by EPFO/ESIC, such as gig, migrant, and informal workers.

services.ai_summary: e-Shram registers unorganised workers (16-59, not EPFO/ESIC) for social security; free Aadhaar-based.
services.ai_explanation: e-Shram builds a national registry of informal workers using Aadhaar and bank details. Registered workers get a UAN-based e-Shram card and become eligible for various welfare schemes. It is free and complements EPFO/ESIC coverage.

services.name: EPF / UAN Services (Employees' Provident Fund)
services.description: Mandatory provident fund, pension (EPS), and insurance (EDLI) for organised-sector employees; managed via UAN.
services.eligibility: Employees with basic wage up to statutory limit in establishments covered under EPF Act.
services.benefits: Retirement corpus with interest, pension, withdrawal/advance facilities, transfer on job change.
application_steps: Activate UAN on EPFO member portal / UMANG.
Seed Aadhaar, bank, PAN via KYC.
Track claim status; amount credited to bank.
services.processing_time: Claims typically 7-20 days after verification.
services.fees: No fee; statutory contributions by employer/employee.
services.validity: Account active until final settlement/transfer.
services.office_locator_info: Regional EPFO offices; locate via portal.

faq.q: How do I check my PF balance?
faq.a: Via UMANG app, EPFO missed call 9966044425, or member portal.

services.ai_summary: EPFO manages EPF/EPS/EDLI for organised employees via UAN; online claims and transfers.
services.ai_explanation: Employees contribute to EPF with employer matching; the UAN ties multiple member IDs across jobs. Members can seed KYC and file online claims for withdrawal, transfer, or advances. Balance and status are checkable via UMANG or the member portal.

services.name: ESIC (Employees' State Insurance)
services.description: Social security and health insurance scheme for workers in covered establishments (medical, sickness, maternity, disability benefits).
services.eligibility: Employees with wage up to Rs. 21,000/month (Rs. 25,000 for persons with disability) in ESIC-covered factories/establishments.
services.benefits: Cashless medical care for worker and family, sickness/maternity benefits, disability and dependent benefits.
services.application_mode: Employer enrols; employee uses ESIC portal / dispensaries
application_steps: Employer registers establishment and enrols employees (Form 1).
Avail treatment at ESIC dispensary/hospital with card.
services.processing_time: Enrolment by employer; benefits as per claim processing.
services.fees: Contribution by employer (3.25%) and employee (0.75%) on wages.
services.validity: Coverage while in covered employment; continue via scheme provisions.
services.office_locator_info: ESIC dispensaries, hospitals, and regional offices.

faq.q: What is the wage ceiling for ESIC?
faq.a: Rs. 21,000/month (Rs. 25,000 for persons with disability).

services.ai_summary: ESIC provides medical and cash benefits to covered workers (wage <= Rs. 21,000) via employer enrolment.
services.ai_explanation: ESIC is a contributory social insurance scheme where employer and employee contribute a percentage of wages. Covered workers and their families get cashless medical care plus sickness, maternity, and disability benefits. Enrolment is done by the employer.

services.validity: Valid until cancelled/updated; revalidate as per rules.

services.ai_explanation: Eligible Indian startups (<=10 years, turnover <= Rs. 100 crore) self-apply for DPIIT recognition, unlocking income-tax exemptions, faster IP protection, self-certification on labour laws, and easier public procurement. Recognition is free.

services.name: GeM (Government e-Marketplace)

services.office_locator_info: GeM regional outreach; buyer organisations.

services.ai_explanation: GeM is an open e-marketplace where government departments buy goods/services and businesses (including MSMEs) sell. It brings transparency, MSE preferences, and faster payments. Sellers register with business and tax details and list catalogues.

faqs.question: Is Aadhaar mandatory for all schemes?
faqs.answer: Aadhaar is required for subsidies/benefits under Section 7 schemes; alternative ID is permitted where Aadhaar not yet assigned.

faqs.question: How do I lock/unlock biometrics?
faqs.answer: Use the TOTP-based lock feature on myAadhaar portal or mAadhaar app.

faqs.question: Can I apply from a different state than my address?
faqs.answer: You must apply from your current address jurisdiction; police verification happens at the address given.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Normal and Tatkaal?
faqs.answer: Tatkaal is an expedited service with higher fees and pre-verification; Normal follows standard police verification.

faqs.question: Can NRI citizens enrol?
faqs.answer: Yes, under Form 6A if aged 18+ and not enrolled in India.

faqs.question: Is Aadhaar mandatory for voter enrolment?
faqs.answer: No, Aadhaar is voluntary for identity; other documents are accepted.

faqs.question: Why is my instalment pending?
faqs.answer: Commonly due to Aadhaar-bank seeding mismatch or pending e-KYC; complete e-KYC on the portal.

faqs.question: Are tenant farmers eligible?
faqs.answer: Benefit is linked to landholding records in the owner's name; tenant farmers are generally not separate beneficiaries.

faqs.question: Which states are covered?
faqs.answer: Most states with APMC integration; check the mandi list on the portal.

faqs.question: How do I know if I am eligible?
faqs.answer: Search your name by state/district/SECC ID on the Beneficiary Portal.

faqs.question: Is there a premium to pay?
faqs.answer: No. The scheme is fully funded by Government; beneficiaries pay nothing at empanelled hospitals.

faqs.question: Is ABHA mandatory?
faqs.answer: No, it is voluntary; you can opt out.

faqs.question: Is my health data safe?
faqs.answer: Sharing is consent-based and governed by the ABDM data-sharing framework.

faqs.question: Who should register on e-Shram?
faqs.answer: Unorganised workers not covered by EPFO/ESIC, such as gig, migrant, and informal workers.

faqs.question: How do I check my PF balance?
faqs.answer: Via UMANG app, EPFO missed call 9966044425, or member portal.

faqs.question: What is the wage ceiling for ESIC?
faqs.answer: Rs. 21,000/month (Rs. 25,000 for persons with disability).

faqs.question: Is NCS free?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration and job search are free for all.

faqs.question: Is Aadhaar mandatory for Udyam?
faqs.answer: Yes, Aadhaar of the owner/partner/director is required for registration.

faqs.question: Is there a fee?
faqs.answer: No government fee for Udyam registration.

faqs.question: What is the age/turnover limit for a startup?
faqs.answer: Incorporated <=10 years, turnover <= Rs. 100 crore, Indian entity.

faqs.question: Is GeM only for government buyers?
faqs.answer: Buyers are government entities; sellers can be any eligible business/MSME.

faqs.question: Which ITR form do I use?
faqs.answer: Depends on income source (salary, business, capital gains); portal helps select.

faqs.question: Is Aadhaar-PAN linking mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, PAN becomes inoperative if not linked with Aadhaar (with exceptions).

faqs.question: What is the GST turnover threshold?
faqs.answer: Generally Rs. 20 lakh (Rs. 10 lakh in special category states, Rs. 40 lakh for goods in some states).

faqs.question: Are DigiLocker documents legally valid?
faqs.answer: Yes, e-documents via DigiLocker are recognised under the IT Act as per Gazette notification.

faqs.question: Which services are on UMANG?
faqs.answer: Hundreds across EPFO, tax, passport, education, utilities, and states.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for PMAY-U?
faqs.answer: EWS/LIG/MIG urban households without a pucca house, meeting income limits.

faqs.question: Can I apply to multiple schemes?
faqs.answer: Only one central scheme at a time generally; multiple where permitted.

faqs.question: Are SWAYAM certificates free?
faqs.answer: Courses are free; a fee applies only for the proctored certificate exam.

faqs.question: Who can open an ABC account?
faqs.answer: Students of ABC-participating higher education institutions.

faqs.question: Can I get my DL on DigiLocker?
faqs.answer: Yes, issued DL/RC can be fetched in DigiLocker.

faqs.question: Is a driving test mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, for permanent DL after learner licence period.

faqs.question: What certificates can I get here?
faqs.answer: Caste, income, residence, birth/death, and many scheme applications.

faqs.question: What is 7/12 (Satbara)?
faqs.answer: It is the land record showing ownership, area, crop, and tenure of a plot in Maharashtra.

faqs.question: How do I add a member to my ration card?
faqs.answer: Apply for modification at the rationing office / portal with proof.

faqs.question: Which schemes are on MahaDBT?
faqs.answer: Post-matric scholarships (SC/ST/OBC/Minority/EBC) and other state DBT schemes.

faqs.question: Are Maharashtra RTO services on Parivahan?
faqs.answer: Yes, DL/RC services use the national Parivahan/Sarathi platform with state integration.
